result:
Braces balance (913/913).

Selectors added: `.experience-toggle` (+`__icon`, `[data-mode="peaceful|chaotic"]`, hover/media states) and `input.vol-slider[type="range"]` with full `::-webkit-slider-{runnable-track,thumb}` / `::-moz-range-{track,thumb,progress}` / `:focus-visible` cross-browser set.

Differentiation: peaceful uses `--rose-strong`/`--blush` (calm), chaotic uses `--flare-strong`/`--flare` (energetic) — same base pill shape/size/hover language as `.sound-toggle`, both legible in Sunlit and Dusk since every value is a theme token.

Risk: the slider fill relies on a `--p` custom property (0–1, matching the existing `--p` convention used by `.fly-hint__fill`/loaderBar) that JS must set on `input.vol-slider` for a live fill — until the parallel sound.js agent wires that up, sliders render at a static 50% fill (still fully functional/draggable, just visually inert until wired).
